high_level_description: stc brand style, an stc spokesperson testimonial shot of a Saudi man in traditional dress speaking to camera against a plain studio backdrop.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A plain light grey studio backdrop with soft diagonal light streaks, giving a clean, minimal broadcast-interview look.

elements.desc: A Saudi man wearing a white thobe and a red-and-white checkered ghutra secured with a black agal, mid-sentence with an animated expression, a small lavalier microphone clipped to his collar.
A purple stc-branded badge with a pen clipped to the man's chest pocket, alongside a visible identification lanyard.
A white lower-third caption bar in the bottom right identifying the speaker by name and affiliation.
